shortDescription: Library mod: gives any pawn randomly rolled, hidden-until-discovered titan traits and materials, with naming, inheritance, visuals, light, ability AI and player settings. Content mods define the traits.
body:
## Purpose
Library mod for a later dungeon mod. Gives any pawn (animal, humanlike, mech) a set of rolled traits and a material. Content mods define the traits; this mod handles storage, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, visuals, light, materials, ability AI, hiding of undiscovered traits and diets.

## Status
- Phase 1, visuals, materials, light, settings (tabs), ability AI, lead-in discovery, hiding undiscovered traits, Biotech human birth inheritance: all tested (last summary commit 5fe4263).
- **Phase 3 step 4, diet traits (builds 46–50, reviewed at 49, not yet tested).**
- Phase 3 remaining: optional VRE gene compat.

## Startup
Settings load in the Mod constructor. Harmony PatchAll runs in `[StaticConstructorOnStartup] TitanPatcher` after defs load (patching PregnancyUtility from the Mod ctor broke pawn generation, run #48; lore saved).

## Diet (Source/TitanDiet.cs, TitanTraitDef.diet)
- XML `diet`: addFoodTypes, removeFoodTypes (FoodTypeFlags, comma list), refuseFoods (ThingDefs), extraFoods (thing + nutrition per unit for non-food), hunts (bool?).
- Hediff_Titan.Diet merges every trait's diet plus the creature's own material (non-food, nutrition = setting `materialNutritionPerUnit`, default 0.05, 0 = off). Rebuilt with the stage (traits, material, settings changes). Null when nothing changes the diet.
- FoodUtility.FoodIsSuitable postfix: added food types / ingestible extraFoods become edible; refused foods (refuseFoods, removed types unless explicitly listed) are never eaten. Like vanilla animal diets: no allowed food means starving.
- PawnUtility.IsPotentiallyPredator postfix: `hunts` true/false. Removing Corpse on any trait always stops hunting (vanilla's hunt job eats the kill without a diet check). ConfigError when one trait sets both.
- FoodUtility.BestFoodSourceOnMap postfix: when the race doesn't eat plants but the diet adds them and nothing was found, search nearby plants (vanilla region limit, rope check). Animal then eats the plant with a vanilla Ingest job.
- JobGiver_GetFood.TryGiveJob postfix: when hungry and vanilla found nothing, look for diet non-food (material, chunks...) and start TF_EatNonFood: walk, chew 300–1500 ticks, consume job.count units, add nutrition. Thing defs are never changed into food. Respects forbidden for colony animals; wild ones eat anything they find. Rope check and vanilla region limit (private GetMaxRegionsToScan via delegate with a fallback).
- Known gaps: JobGiver_EatRandom and the right-click ingest menu use the race's diet directly; diet-added foods override willNeverEat and mutant food types.
- Examples: Rockgut (eats stone chunks, 0.5 each), Bloodthirsty (meat + corpse, no plants, hunts). Both visible.

## Inheritance (Source/Patches.cs)
BirthContext records parents in DoBirthSpawn, CompHatcher.Hatch, PregnancyUtility.ApplyBirthOutcome. TrySpawnHatchedOrBornPawn prefix applies before spawn; ApplyBirthOutcome postfix covers doctor-carry. Material from a parent (coin flip if both), traits by 1-(1-chance×setting)^carriers, discovered if a parent knew it.

## Ability AI (Source/TitanAI.cs)
Postfix on DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob runs JobGiver_TitanAbilities every 30 ticks when the constant tree gave nothing: trait aiThinkTrees, then offensive trait abilities at the current enemy, then self-targeted ones. Not for player colonists. Setting `abilityAI`. Content note: animal abilities need displayGizmoWhileUndrafted for the tamed gizmo.

## Discovery of ability traits
Notify_PawnUsedVerb on resolve; Ability.Notify_StartedCasting prefix+postfix wraps this cast's preCastActions so the reveal happens when the visible lead-in starts.

## Hiding undiscovered traits (Source/TitanHiding.cs)
During DrawStatsReport for a titan with hidden traits: discovered-only stage, null stage for hediffs only hidden traits grant, capacities dirtied and stat caches cleared before and after. Ability.GizmosVisible postfix hides abilities only hidden traits grant. Not hidden: pain/bleed, hidden hediffs' comps, health tab capacities.

## Mod settings (TitanSettings)
Tabs: Lights and effects / Traits / Materials. Materials tab now also has "Nutrition from eating own material (per unit)" 0–0.5.

## TitanTraitDef
Generation, discovery, naming, inheritance, effects (stage, hediffs, abilities, aiThinkTree, diet, traitClass), visuals.

## Harmony patches (25)
BestKindLabel; ApplyBirthOutcome ×3; DoBirthSpawn ×2; CompHatcher.Hatch ×2; TrySpawnHatchedOrBornPawn; DropBloodFilth/DropBloodSmear; MakeCorpse; Corpse.IngestibleNow; Pawn.ButcherProducts; DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob; Ability.Notify_StartedCasting ×2; DrawStatsReport ×2; Hediff.CurStage; Ability.GizmosVisible; FoodIsSuitable; IsPotentiallyPredator; BestFoodSourceOnMap; JobGiver_GetFood.TryGiveJob.

## Debug actions ("Titan Framework")
Add trait…, Roll traits…, Set material…, Discover all traits, Clear titan.

## Example content (Defs/Examples + Patches/TF_ExampleMaterials.xml): remove both together before publishing
Flaming, Venomous, Ironhide, Of the Deep, Rockgut, Bloodthirsty, Brittle, Irradiated (Uranium), Firebreather (Biotech).
